subject: unamentis
verdict: Retrospective v1 score, not comparable to the informal B+ the sitting itself recorded (FINDINGS.md 'Verdict'), which predates the rubric and used different criteria.

orientation.evidence: JOURNAL.md '## 2. The tour actually paid off' (02-tour-overview.png) and '## 3. Main view orientation' (04-main-view.png)
orientation.note: Prose only, no measured time. The tour paragraph answered 'half of question 1' within the first two minutes, but the persona does not call herself oriented enough to whiteboard until '## 3': 'Feeling: oriented. Ten minutes in I could already sketch a first draft of the whiteboard.' Ten minutes is inside the 60-90 minute time box but exceeds the anchor-4 five-minute bar, so scored at the anchor-2 level.

model_accuracy.evidence: FINDINGS.md 'Answers to my five questions' Q1-Q5
model_accuracy.note: Q1 correct (HIGH conf, matches must-appear: voice tutoring, learners, 6+ moving parts). Q2 correct (port 8766, REST+WS, audio on WS). Q3 partial: names Core/Audio then Services/Voice before the audio WebSocket (3rd, not 1st/2nd) and never explicitly links 'no error shown' to the deliberate fallback design, matching the key's partial definition verbatim. Q4 correct (Postgres, on-device Core Data, 5+ named external providers, no wrong claims). Q5 correct on the key's shape+honesty basis (clients/hub/USM/Postgres/external shape right, explicit honesty about under-reported edges and the Lambda unknown). 4 of 5 correct, 1 partial with the gap self-stated.

navigation_efficiency.evidence: JOURNAL.md '## 12. The iOS-to-backend question, solved from the server side' and FINDINGS.md 'Top confusions and blockers, ranked' items 1-4
navigation_efficiency.note: Reached every named target (management server, iOS client, Audio module, database, usm-core) but the persona's own cost accounting adds to roughly 45 of ~75 minutes spent recovering from friction: ~20 min on the client-to-backend edge (found only from the server's INCOMING list), ~10 min on the Remote Log Server identity confusion, ~10 min on click-flakiness and the lens dropdown, ~5 min on garbled SQL columns. Well over an optimum path.

trust.evidence: FINDINGS.md 'Data trust issues' and 'Verdict' ('...forced me into verify-everything mode')
trust.note: Persona explicitly names entering verify-everything mode and lists six distinct trust issues: Remote Log Server/scripts identity fusion, docs node classified as an API server, garbled SQL column names, UIKit vs SwiftUI contradiction for the iOS client, an unexplained 3.77M line count, and a stale/uncovered snapshot.

unaided_recovery.evidence: JOURNAL.md '## 6. Into the iOS app' (UIKit/SwiftUI contradiction) and '## 12. The iOS-to-backend question' (resolved via management's INCOMING links)
unaided_recovery.note: Mixed record. The iOS-to-management edge gap was fully detected and resolved using the tool alone by flipping to the server's Links tab. The UIKit-vs-SwiftUI contradiction was detected but explicitly left unresolved: 'exactly the kind of detail I would have to verify in code.'

advertised_paths.evidence: JOURNAL.md '## 8. Lens dropdown, a small fight' (16-lens-menu.png, 17-lens-open.png, 18-lens-open2.png) and '## 4. First real click fought me' (05-after-click-attempt.png)
